title: Understanding Principal Components
text: Look at the scatterplot of the first two principal components. Notice how the points are grouped into three distinct clusters. Each cluster represents a different type of visitor behavior.

title: Analyzing the First Row of $$V^T$$
text: The first row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the first principal component. Higher values indicate a stronger influence on this component. Which exhibits have the highest values?

title: Analyzing the Second Row of $$V^T$$
text: The second row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the second principal component. Look for the exhibits with the highest values here. How do they differ from the first row?

hintAnswer: These visitors spend a lot of time at the activities (train and playground).
title: Identifying the Top Group
text: Based on the plots of $$V^T$$, which exhibits do the top group of visitors spend the most time at?
choices: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the activities (train and playground).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the reptile exhibits (turtle, iguana, and alligator).
These visitors spend very little time at any of the $$8$$ exhibits.
These visitors spend about the same amount of time at every exhibit.
